tools.name: wever_delegated-authority
tools.title: Wever Labs Delegated Authority
tools.description:
Paid URL: 2.00 USDC per mandate on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Only issue_mandate is billed; GET, contract reads, drafts and all other modes have no x402 fee. Credentials and grants remain required for their existing operations. Read the backend 402 body for x402 terms. Issue signed mandates and operator-approved action grants, then let credentialed agents consume them to create immutable work-order records. Records do not perform work, deliver results or authorize payment.
Operating boundary: Operators issue mandates and approve each exact action grant with an issuance idempotency key. Only the bound credentialed agent may consume a grant; each action grant atomically reserves one nonfinancial work_order unit. Usage and attribution are credential-bound. Signed authority permits only immutable record creation, never work execution, delivery or payment. Public drafts remain unsigned_dev and cannot execute. The access fee applies only to issue_mandate and never authorizes downstream spending. GET, contract reads, drafts and all other authority modes have no x402 fee; their existing credential checks remain.
POST /api/delegated-authority. Existing product credentials, signed mandates, and single-use action grants remain required where applicable. This adapter grants no authority and never supplies server credentials. This current operation is a credentialed authority control plane for immutable work-order record creation. It does not execute the recorded work, deliver results, or authorize payment. Operator issuance and grant approval require X-Wever-Operator-Key and Idempotency-Key; consumption requires the target agent's X-Wever-Agent-Key. Usage and attribution come from validated credentials and durable authority records. AP2 issuance also accepts issue_mandate with mandate.profile com.weverlabs.ap2.direct-checkout.1, the holder public key, signed checkout challenge, consent digest and bounded expiry. It requires a dedicated AP2 issuer credential in X-Wever-Operator-Key, Idempotency-Key and a fresh holder wallet proof. Issuance costs 2.00 USDC per issued mandate; verification at /api/ap2-mandate-gateway costs 0.10 USDC per call, subject to the same shared free allowance. The AP2 mandate records checkout intent and grants no tool access, execution authority or spending authority.

inputSchema.description: Exact delegated-authority v2 request shapes. Credentials and issuance idempotency keys are HTTP headers, never tool arguments. The backend additionally enforces signed cross-field bindings, active time windows, credential-bound usage, exact approved action digests and durable allowance state.

oneOf.description: Read the public contract. This performs no authority issuance or downstream write.
Validate a public unsigned_dev draft. It is not signed, persisted or executable. Expiry must follow not_before by no more than 30 days.
Requires X-Wever-Operator-Key and Idempotency-Key. Issue one durable signed mandate for a configured agent. The active time window is limited to 30 days from issuance.
Requires the issuing operator X-Wever-Operator-Key and Idempotency-Key. Reserve one work_order unit and approve this exact action for at most 300 seconds. An agent cannot issue its own grant.

Requires the target agent X-Wever-Agent-Key. Consume the signed grant once to create its immutable work-order record. This does not execute the recorded work, deliver results or authorize payment. A pending or unknown result is not success; retry the same grant or inspect it, never substitute new authority.
Requires the bound agent X-Wever-Agent-Key. Read durable grant state and any finalized result.
Requires the issuing operator X-Wever-Operator-Key. Revoke future authority. Revocation does not undo a committed work-order record or release an uncertain in-flight effect.
Requires the bound agent X-Wever-Agent-Key. Read this mandate audit after the supplied cursor, default 0, with a default limit of 50.

usage.description: Must match the target agent usage configured on the server. Caller input cannot change credential-bound usage or attribution.

mandateInput.description: Only create_delegated_work_order is enabled. max_units counts work-order records, not currency. The server enforces time relationships and configured agent scope/usage. consent_digest records operator-attested consent, not independent verification.

workOrderAction.description: The exact approved immutable work-order content. No caller-supplied attribution, identifiers, prices, callback URLs or execution claims are accepted.
